author: PoutyJinx
name: SinPurge
short: Purge recent messages from a specific user.
description: SIN Corporation moderation tool for Red-DiscordBot. Purge recent messages from a user across one or all channels, including voice-channel chats, banned or left users, optional timeout durations, and configurable mod-log reports.
install_msg: SIN Purge installed. Use `[p]sinpurge @user 1h`, `[p]sinpurge USER_ID 1h all none`, `/sinpurge`, and configure reports with `[p]sinpurgeset modlog #channel`.
